title: Adapting In-context Generation for Enhanced Composed Image Retrieval

layout.note: Left column: two stacked lettered lanes, (a) prior zero-shot generation above (b) the proposed version, each a small left-to-right pipeline ending in a tick/cross verdict row. A dash-dot rule divides it from the right column of two dotted-frame galleries (fashion above real-life), each a 2 x 3 grid of image-pair cards.

lesson: Contrast prior and proposed pipelines as two lettered lanes that reuse one model glyph, change only the adapter, and end each lane in a tick/cross verdict row. Then let titled galleries of real outputs, each with a coloured edit-type caption, carry the quality claim.
